凰溪岛的六月，毒辣的太阳像块烧红的烙铁，炙烤着滨海大道旁的武道测试场。
暗红色的气血检测碑矗立在广场中央，三米高的石碑表面流淌着淡金色纹路，每隔十秒便会发出一道嗡鸣，将测试者的气血数值投射到空中的全息屏幕上。
碑前排起的长队像条扭曲的长龙，少年少女们穿着统一的黑色武道服，脸上或兴奋、或紧张、或忐忑，唯有队伍末尾的那道身影，显得格格不入。
贾黑米低着头，指尖无意识地摩挲着武道服袖口磨破的边角。
他的武道服是三年前的旧款，洗得发白，裤脚还缝着两块补丁，与周围同龄人崭新挺括的服装形成刺眼对比。
更扎眼的是他的身形——一米七五的身高，体重却不足五十公斤，瘦削的肩膀微微佝偻，脸色是长期营养不良的蜡黄，连脖颈处的血管都清晰可见，活脱脱一副风一吹就倒的模样。
“下一个，贾黑米！”
测试台上传来监考老师不耐烦的喊声，声音透过扩音器，在喧闹的广场上撕开一道口子。
周围瞬间安静了几分，不少目光齐刷刷投向队伍末尾，有戏谑，有怜悯，更多的是习以为常的漠然。
贾黑米深吸一口气，攥紧了藏在口袋里的手。
掌心沁出的冷汗浸湿了那张皱巴巴的体检表，表格右上角的“气血预估：0.3卡”字样，像一根针，扎得他心脏发紧。
灵气复苏百年，蓝星早已不是曾经的科技时代。
百年前，第一缕灵气穿透大气层，沉睡的上古异兽苏醒，克系邪神的低语在人类意识深处回荡，世界秩序塌，废土蔓延，都市沦为孤岛。
为了生存，人类觉醒了修炼之路——气血武道淬炼肉身，序列异能掌控超凡，而气血值，便是衡量一个人是否具备修炼资格的最低标准。
正常成年人的气血值为1.0卡，年满十八岁的少年，气血值若低于0.8卡，便会被判定为“无修炼资格”，终生只能沦为底层，要么在都市的角落苟延残喘，要么被流放到废土边境，成为异兽的口粮。
而贾黑米，自十六岁第一次检测气血以来，数值就从未超过0.5卡。
“磨磨蹭蹭干什么？快点！”监考老师敲了敲测试台，语气愈发不耐。
这是凰溪岛一年一度的武道资格预选，关系到三个月后的武道高考名额，谁都不想在一个“废柴”身上浪费时间。
贾黑米咬紧牙关，快步走上测试台。

脚下的合金地板被太阳晒得发烫，隔着薄薄的武道鞋，都能感受到灼人的温度，就像周围那些毫不掩饰的目光。
他走到气血检测碑前，按照流程，将双手按在冰凉的石碑表面。
石碑上的金色纹路瞬间亮起，一股温和的能量顺着掌心涌入体内，游走在四肢百骸，像是在探查他身体的每一寸肌理。
贾黑米能清晰地感觉到，那股能量在触及他的心脏时，微微一顿，随即像是遇到了什么阻碍，快速退回了石碑。
“嗡——”
全息屏幕上，一串数字缓缓跳动，最终定格在刺眼的红色字体上：
【检测对象：贾黑米】
【年龄：19岁】
【气血值：0.2卡】
【序列觉醒：无】
【评定等级：f-（无修炼资格）】
广场上顿时响起一阵压抑的哄笑。
“我就说吧，还是0.2卡，比去年还降了0.1！”
“真是个奇葩，别人都是越练越高，他倒好，越活越回去了。”
“凰溪岛百年难遇的废柴，果然名不虚传。”
“这种人还来参加测试？浪费资源罢了。”
尖酸刻薄的议论声像针一样扎进贾黑米的耳朵，他猛地攥紧拳头，指甲深深嵌入掌心，带来一阵尖锐的疼痛，却让他混沌的大脑清醒了几分。
他不是没有努力过。
三年来，他每天天不亮就去凰溪山的晨雾中练基础拳，晚上借着路灯的光背诵武道理论，省吃俭用攒钱买最便宜的气血药剂，甚至偷偷去废土边缘的垃圾场捡异兽骸骨提炼精血——可无论他怎么拼，气血值就像焊死在了0.5卡以下，甚至还在缓慢下滑。
医生说他是天生的“气血阻滞体质”，经脉堵塞，无法吸收灵气转化为气血，这辈子都注定与武道无缘。

“好了，下一个。”监考老师面无表情地挥挥手，像驱赶一只苍蝇，“把表格拿好，回去等着通知——哦，忘了，你这种情况，根本不需要通知。”
最后一句话，像是一把重锤，狠狠砸在贾黑米的心上。
他脸色惨白，几乎站不稳，伸手去拿体检表时，手指都在颤抖。就在这时，一道娇俏中带着嘲讽的声音响起：

In June on Huangxi Island, the scorching sun was like a red-hot iron, scorching the martial arts testing ground next to Binhai Avenue.
A dark red qi and blood test monument stands in the center of the square. The surface of the three-meter-high stone tablet has light golden lines flowing on it. It will emit a buzz every ten seconds and project the tester's qi and blood values ​​onto the holographic screen in the air.
The long queue in front of the monument was like a twisted dragon. The boys and girls were wearing uniform black martial arts uniforms. Their faces were either excited, nervous, or apprehensive. Only the figure at the end of the queue seemed out of place.
Jia Heimi lowered his head and unconsciously rubbed the frayed edges of the cuffs of his martial arts uniform with his fingertips.
His martial arts uniform was an old model from three years ago, washed white, and there were two patches sewn on the trousers, which formed a dazzling contrast with the new and crisp clothing of his peers around him.
What is even more eye-catching is his figure - he is 1.75 meters tall but weighs less than 50 kilograms. His thin shoulders are slightly stooped, his face is sallow due to long-term malnutrition, and even the blood vessels in his neck are clearly visible. He looks like he will collapse if the wind blows.
"Next, Jahmi!"
The invigilator's impatient shout came from the testing platform, and the sound penetrated the loudspeaker and tore a hole in the noisy square.
The surroundings became a little quiet for a moment, and many eyes were directed towards the end of the team, some were joking, some were pity, and most of them were accustomed to indifference.
Jiahemi took a deep breath and clenched the hands hidden in his pockets.
The cold sweat from his palms soaked the crumpled physical examination form. The words "Estimated Qi and Blood: 0.3 Calories" in the upper right corner of the form were like a needle, pricking his heart.
A hundred years after the revival of spiritual energy, Blue Star is no longer the technological era it once was.
A hundred years ago, the first ray of spiritual energy penetrated the atmosphere, sleeping ancient beasts awakened, and the whispers of evil gods echoed in the depths of human consciousness. The world order collapsed, wastelands spread, and cities became isolated islands.
In order to survive, human beings have awakened to the path of cultivation - tempering the physical body with Qi and blood martial arts, and controlling extraordinary abilities. The Qi and blood value is the minimum standard to measure whether a person is qualified to practice.
The qi and blood value of a normal adult is 1.0 calories. If the qi and blood value of a teenager over the age of 18 is lower than 0.8 calories, he will be judged as "not qualified to practice" and will be reduced to the bottom class for life. He will either linger in the corner of the city or be exiled to the wasteland border and become the food of alien beasts.
As for Jia Heimi, since he first tested his qi and blood at the age of sixteen, the value has never exceeded 0.5 calories.
"What are you waiting for? Hurry up!" The invigilator knocked on the test table, his tone becoming more and more impatient.
This is Huangxi Island's annual martial arts qualification preliminaries. It is related to the quota for the martial arts college entrance examination three months later. No one wants to waste time on a "waste".
Jiahemi gritted his teeth and walked quickly onto the testing platform.
The alloy floor beneath my feet was hot from the sun, and through my thin martial arts shoes, I could feel the scorching heat, just like the unabashed gazes around me.
He walked to the Qi and Blood Testing Tablet, followed the procedure, and pressed his hands on the cold surface of the stone tablet.
The golden lines on the stone tablet lit up instantly, and a gentle energy poured into his body along the palm of his hand, wandering around his limbs and bones, as if exploring every inch of his body's texture.
Jiahemi could clearly feel that when the energy touched his heart, he paused slightly, and then quickly retreated back to the stone monument as if he encountered some obstacle.
"Buzz——"
On the holographic screen, a series of numbers slowly beat, and finally settled on the dazzling red font:
[Test object: Jia Heimi]
[Age: 19 years old]
[Vitality value: 0.2 cards]
[Sequence Awakening: None]
[Assessment level: f- (no cultivation qualification)]
A burst of suppressed laughter suddenly erupted in the square.
"Let me just say, it's still 0.2 calories, which is 0.1 lower than last year!"
"It's really weird. Others are getting better as they practice.Fortunately for him, he returned home as he lived. "
“Huangxi Island’s reputation as a once-in-a-hundred-year-old loser really lives up to its reputation. "
"This kind of person still comes to take the test? Just a waste of resources. "
The vitriolic comments pierced Jiahemi's ears like needles. He clenched his fists suddenly, and his nails dug deeply into his palms, causing a sharp pain, but it made his chaotic brain clear up a little.
It's not like he didn't work hard.
For three years, he went to Huangxi Mountain every day before dawn to practice basic boxing in the morning mist. At night, he recited martial arts theories by the light of street lamps. He frugally saved money to buy the cheapest qi and blood potions. He even secretly went to the garbage dump on the edge of the wasteland to pick up the bones of alien beasts to refine blood essence. But no matter how hard he tried, his qi and blood value seemed to be welded to below 0.5 calories, and was even slowly declining.
The doctor said that he was born with a "qi and blood blockage constitution". His meridians were blocked and he was unable to absorb spiritual energy and convert it into qi and blood. He was destined to have no chance of martial arts in his life.
"Okay, next one. "The invigilator waved his hand expressionlessly, as if to ward off a fly, "Take the form and go back and wait for the notification - oh, I forgot, in your case, there is no need to notify at all. "
The last sentence was like a heavy hammer, hitting Jiahemi's heart hard.
His face was pale and he could hardly stand. When he reached for the medical examination form, his fingers were trembling. At this moment, a charming and mocking voice sounded:
